  • Class
    Description
    CompositedWindowHost
    The seam the conventional 2D desktop uses to obtain a Swing surface for a composited (redirected) native X11 window, so that window can be hosted inside a Desktop2DWindow instead of escaping as a separate top-level window owned by the host window manager.
    CompositedWindowHost.HostedWindow
    A live hosted surface: the Swing component to embed, plus the resize and teardown hooks the desktop controller drives as the client window changes.
    CompositedWindowPipeline
    Wires one WindowPixelSource to one CompositedWindowSink: on a damage report it reads the damaged region and presents it to the sink.
    CompositedWindowSet
    The multi-window focus and stacking model for a set of composited native windows (Phase C).
    CompositedWindowSet.FocusPolicy
    How input focus moves between composited windows.
    CompositedWindowSink
    The presentation end of the compositor's shared pixel pipeline: something that shows a freshly-read region of a redirected client window.
    CompositeWindowImageLoader
    Pure-Java pixel pipeline from a Composite offscreen pixmap into the TiledNativeWindowImage tiles that back a NativeWindow3D.
    ConfigureNotifyBugFixed
     
    DamageAccumulator
    Coalesces the damage rectangles reported for one composited window into a single bounding region, so the compositor reads back and re-uploads only the union of what actually changed instead of the whole window on every repaint (Phase E: damage-region readback + texture-upload batching).
    DamageAccumulator.Region
    An immutable coalesced damage region.
    FramePacer
    Throttles how often a composited window's accumulated damage is read back and presented, so unchanged regions are not re-read and re-uploaded more often than the target frame interval (Phase E: frame pacing).
    GlBringUpPlanner
    The pure decision layer for bringing Java 3D up on the target GL stack (Phase F).
    GlBringUpPlanner.Probe
    The immutable probe inputs the planner decides over.
    GlBringUpPlanner.Verdict
    The outcome of a target GL/DRI3 bring-up probe.
    NetWmState
    The pure, X-free decision layer for the EWMH subset the compositor needs (Phase D): _NET_WM_STATE change application, the default state for a window type, the _NET_WM_ALLOWED_ACTIONS derivation, and the _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW focus-stealing decision.
    NetWmState.Action
    The _NET_WM_ACTION_* atoms this WM advertises.
    NetWmState.ActiveDecision
    The outcome of an _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW request.
    NetWmState.ActiveSource
    How an activation request was initiated (EWMH _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW).
    NetWmState.ChangeAction
    The _NET_WM_STATE client-message action field (EWMH §5.9).
    NetWmState.State
    The _NET_WM_STATE_* atoms this WM understands.
    NetWmState.WindowType
    The _NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE_* atoms, minus the bare type key.
    ReadbackPlanner
    Chooses the pixel readback transport for a composited region and sizes the buffer it needs (Phase E: MIT-SHM fast path).
    ReadbackPlanner.Path
    The readback transport for one region.
    SessionLifecycle
    The pure state machine for lg3d's life as the sole X session client on a bare-Xorg/LFS host (Phase G): the xinit/systemd hand-off starts it, it acquires the WM + compositor and runs, a clean logout tears it down in a fixed order, and a crash may be recovered up to a bounded number of times.
    SessionLifecycle.Event
    The events that drive transitions.
    SessionLifecycle.State
    The session states.
    SwingCompositedWindowSink
    The 2D CompositedWindowSink: paints a redirected client window's pixels into a Swing component that the conventional 2D desktop can host inside a Desktop2DWindow, so a native X11 application appears within the desktop rather than escaping as a separate top-level window.
    VerifyX11Extensions
    Stage 0 diagnostic for the X11 compositing integration.
    WindowLifecycleListener
    The window-manager lifecycle seam the conventional 2D desktop subscribes to so that native X11 applications appear as ordinary windows inside the 2D desktop.
    WindowLifecycleRegistrar
    The public registration seam for a WindowLifecycleListener.
    WindowPixelSource
    The source end of the compositor's shared pixel pipeline: something that can read a rectangular region of a redirected client window's pixels into a BufferedImage.
    X11CompositedWindowHost
    The production CompositedWindowHost: for a redirected client window it wires the shared pixel pipeline into a Swing surface the 2D desktop can embed.
